Historical research · BTC perpetual · 60-second horizon

Can the order book
predict the next minute?

TLOB ranks first among the two runnable models by full-test balanced accuracy (35.24%). The strongest simple baseline, Depth imbalance, scores 37.09%. The top model does not beat the strongest baseline. There is no tested winner across all four: LOBERT and LOBS5 have no comparable results.

3.73 million real snapshots · 10 contrasting examples frozen before training · 2,367 test minutes · 2 models runnable, 2 unavailable

What is missing

LOBERT: no official runnable release found in the paper/author sources. LOBS5: requires individual-order message history and compatible weights; aggregate BTC snapshots do not supply order IDs or individual cancellations. Neither receives a score or a fabricated forecast.

How to interpret this

Both networks were trained from scratch for three epochs with the same 8,000 historical training windows. January 9–17 trained the models, January 18 selected the epoch, January 19–20 tested them. This limited run cannot establish a generally best model or a profitable strategy.

All times on charts are IST. Source timestamps are UTC. The report embeds its charts and works offline. Detailed scores, source hashes and every prediction are saved alongside this file.
